name: cnn-from-scratch-numpy
title: Build a Trainable CNN from Scratch in NumPy

parts.title: Softmax, Loss, and Metrics Primitives
parts.description: Build the numerically stable softmax, cross-entropy loss, and accuracy helpers used throughout the network.

parts.title: Initialization and Convolution Plumbing
parts.description: He initialization, zero biases, padding, output-shape math, and the im2col / col2im transforms.

parts.title: Layer Forward and Backward Passes
parts.description: Forward and backward routines for convolution, max pooling, ReLU, flatten, and linear layers.

parts.title: Fused Loss and Optimizers
parts.description: Fuse softmax with cross-entropy for stable training and implement SGD and Adam updates.

parts.title: Assembling LeNet
parts.description: Compose the layer primitives into conv/classifier blocks, wire the full LeNet forward/backward, and a predict helper.

parts.title: Synthetic Data Pipeline
parts.description: Generate a synthetic image dataset and build shuffling, train/test splitting, and minibatch iteration.

parts.title: Training Loop and Evaluation
parts.description: A training step, epoch loop, full training driver, and a held-out evaluation routine.

steps.name: argmax_rows
steps.doc: Index of the max per row, shape (N,).

steps.name: row_max
steps.doc: Max per row with keepdims, shape (N,1).

steps.name: row_sum
steps.doc: Sum per row with keepdims, shape (N,1).

steps.name: exp_shifted
steps.doc: Numerically stable exp(x - row_max(x)), shape (N,K).

steps.name: stable_softmax
steps.doc: Row-wise softmax via exp_shifted / row_sum(exp_shifted), shape (N,K).

steps.name: one_hot
steps.doc: One-hot encode integer labels into float rows, shape (N, num_classes).

steps.name: gather_true_class_probs
steps.doc: Pick probs[i, labels[i]] for each row, shape (N,).

steps.name: cross_entropy_loss
steps.doc: Mean of -log(true-class prob + 1e-12) over the batch (scalar float).

steps.name: accuracy
steps.doc: Mean fraction of rows whose argmax equals the label (scalar float).

steps.name: he_std
steps.doc: He initialization standard deviation sqrt(2/fan_in).

steps.name: he_init
steps.doc: Sample an array of `shape` from N(0, he_std(fan_in)) using rng.

steps.name: init_zero_bias
steps.doc: Return a length-n zero bias vector.

steps.name: pad_2d
steps.doc: Zero-pad the spatial dims of an NCHW array by `pad` on each side.

steps.name: output_spatial_size
steps.doc: Convolution/pool output size along one spatial dim.

steps.name: im2col
steps.doc: Extract sliding patches into (N, C*kh*kw, OH*OW), row=channel-major (c,ki,kj).

steps.name: col2im
steps.signature: col2im(cols, x_shape, kh, kw, stride, pad)
steps.doc: Inverse of im2col, accumulating overlapping gradient contributions.

steps.name: conv2d_forward
steps.doc: Forward 2D convolution via im2col returning output and cache.

steps.name: conv2d_grad_input
steps.doc: Gradient of conv output w.r.t. input via col2im.

steps.name: conv2d_grad_weights
steps.doc: Gradient of conv output w.r.t. weights.

steps.name: conv2d_grad_bias
steps.doc: Gradient of conv output w.r.t. bias (sum over N, OH, OW).

steps.name: conv2d_backward
steps.doc: Compose conv input/weight/bias gradients from cache.

steps.name: maxpool2d_forward
steps.doc: Channelwise max over pool x pool windows; returns (out, cache).

steps.name: scatter_grad_window
steps.doc: Route gradient to argmax position of a pooling window (1 at max else 0, times dout_val).

steps.name: maxpool2d_backward
steps.doc: Scatter gradients back to the stored max positions; returns dx.

steps.name: relu_forward
steps.doc: Elementwise max(x, 0); returns (out, cache).

steps.name: relu_backward
steps.doc: dout * (x > 0); returns dx.

steps.name: flatten_forward
steps.doc: Reshape (N,C,H,W) -> (N, C*H*W); cache original shape; returns (out, cache).

steps.name: flatten_backward
steps.doc: Reshape (N, C*H*W) back to original shape; returns dx.

steps.name: linear_forward
steps.doc: x @ W + b; returns (out, cache).

steps.name: linear_grad_input
steps.doc: dout @ W.T; returns dx.

steps.name: linear_grad_weights
steps.doc: x.T @ dout; returns dW.

steps.name: linear_grad_bias
steps.doc: Sum over rows; returns db.

steps.name: linear_backward
steps.doc: Compose linear grads from cache; returns (dx, dW, db).

steps.name: softmax_cross_entropy_forward
steps.doc: Fused softmax + cross-entropy loss; returns (loss, cache) with probs and labels.

steps.name: softmax_cross_entropy_backward
steps.doc: Gradient of fused softmax cross-entropy w.r.t. logits: (probs - one_hot)/N.

steps.name: sgd_step
steps.doc: One vanilla SGD update: param - lr*grad.

steps.name: adam_update_m
steps.doc: Adam first-moment (mean) EMA update: beta1*m + (1-beta1)*grad.

steps.name: adam_update_v
steps.doc: Adam second-moment (uncentered variance) EMA update: beta2*v + (1-beta2)*grad**2.

steps.name: adam_bias_correct
steps.doc: Bias-correct an Adam moment estimate: moment / (1 - beta**t).

steps.name: adam_param_step
steps.doc: Apply a bias-corrected Adam step: param - lr*m_hat/(sqrt(v_hat)+eps).

steps.name: adam_step
steps.signature: adam_step(param, grad, m, v, t, lr=0.001, beta1=0.9, beta2=0.999, eps=1e-08)
steps.doc: Full Adam update for one param at step t (t is the current, already-incremented step); returns (new_param, new_m, new_v).

steps.name: init_conv_layer
steps.doc: Init a conv layer dict with He weights (out_ch,in_ch,k,k), zero bias, stride 1, same-pad.

steps.name: init_linear_layer
steps.doc: Init a linear layer dict with He weights (in,out) and zero bias (out,).

steps.name: init_lenet
steps.doc: Build a small LeNet: 2 conv blocks (3x3 same-pad, pool2) then 2 FC + logits layer.

steps.name: forward_conv_block
steps.doc: Conv -> ReLU -> MaxPool; returns (out, cache) holding the three sub-caches.

steps.name: forward_classifier_block
steps.doc: Linear (optionally followed by ReLU); returns (out, cache).

steps.name: lenet_forward
steps.doc: Run conv blocks -> flatten -> FC blocks (ReLU) -> final linear logits; returns (logits, caches).

steps.name: backward_conv_block
steps.doc: Invert MaxPool -> ReLU -> Conv; returns (dx, {'W':dW,'b':db}).

steps.name: backward_classifier_block
steps.doc: Invert (ReLU ->) Linear; returns (dx, {'W':dW,'b':db}).

steps.name: lenet_backward
steps.doc: Backprop through the whole net; returns grads with the same structure as params.

steps.name: lenet_predict
steps.doc: Return predicted class labels (N,) via argmax of lenet_forward logits.

steps.name: build_synthetic_image_dataset
steps.doc: Build (X (N,1,H,W), y (N,)) of class-dependent images a CNN can learn.

steps.name: shuffle_indices
steps.doc: Return a random permutation of range(n) using rng.

steps.name: train_test_split
steps.doc: Deterministically split into (Xtr, ytr, Xte, yte) by fraction, no shuffle here.

steps.name: iterate_minibatches
steps.doc: Yield (Xb, yb) minibatches covering all data once, optionally shuffled.

steps.name: train_step
steps.signature: train_step(params, X, y, lr, opt_state, t)
steps.doc: One optimization step: lenet forward, softmax-CE loss/grad, lenet backward, Adam-update every param.

steps.name: train_one_epoch
steps.signature: train_one_epoch(params, X, y, batch_size, lr, opt_state, t, rng)
steps.doc: Run one epoch of minibatch Adam training; return params, opt_state, step t, and mean batch loss.

steps.name: train_loop
steps.signature: train_loop(params, X, y, n_epochs, batch_size, lr, rng)
steps.doc: Initialize optimizer state and train for n_epochs of Adam; return params and a loss history.

steps.name: evaluate
steps.doc: Forward pass on held-out data; return (mean cross-entropy loss, accuracy).
